summary_zh: ThinkRail 是一个围绕 pi 编码代理构建的智能体 IDE，支持规格驱动开发，并随使用逐步了解项目。它提供隔离的 git worktree 工作区、Monaco 编辑器、终端、多会话聊天与共享计划，以及持久化的 SPEC.md 规格图、可复用技能和 MCP 服务器连接。
audience_zh: 适合使用 Git 仓库、希望让 AI 代理并行处理开发任务并管理分支和拉取请求的开发者；也适合重视规格文档沉淀、想接入自有模型提供方或扩展/技能体系、偏好桌面应用或浏览器 CLI 工作流的技术用户。

evidence.quote: ThinkRail is the agentic IDE that gets better every time you use it
ThinkRail is an agentic IDE that gets better every time you use it. With Spec-Driven Development support, it learns your project as you work, becoming more capable and helpful over time.

We built a rich interface around the `pi` coding agent, isolated work into separate workspaces, and gave the agent durable project knowledge through the spec graph and reusable skills. We are now adding full extension support, so ThinkRail can create the tools it needs based on how you work.

- **Isolated workspaces.** Open any git repo as a project and create `git worktree` workspaces from it, each with its own branch and working directory. Agents can then work in parallel without touching your original codebase; when they finish, merge the results you want to keep and delete the rest.
